levels.surface: علي بن أحمد بن محمد بن عمران الدقاق

notes: «عن عمه الحسين بن يزيد» is one link: the surface is the name alone (rule 7).
«عمن حدثه» is a gap, unnamed, kept in its place (rule 8).
The Imam named in the words after the chain (Ali, «أمير المؤمنين») is the last link (ruling 2); the Imam Sadiq before him is a narrator.
The compiler's commentary («قال مصنف هذا الكتاب») is not a chain and is left out.
